gbm_population_evidence.quote: Malignant Brain Tumor; Malignant Glioma; Embryonal Tumor

candidate_evidence.quote: indication of treatment with carboplatin, validated in multidisciplinary meeting
The opening of the BBB with the SonoCloud-9 system will increase the tumor exposure to carboplatin

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: recurrence or progression of brain tumor after at least a first line of standard treatment

role_evidence.quote: The opening of the BBB with the SonoCloud-9 system will increase the tumor exposure to carboplatin
Safety of the ultrasound contrast agent SonoVue will also be evaluated in this indication in the pediatric population.

agents.drug_class_hint: ultrasound contrast agent (microbubbles) used for BBB opening

source_quote.quote: An ancillary study will assess circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) concentrations in patients with recurrence of a supra-tentorial malignant brain tumor

coder_notes: Paediatric-only (CHILD) trial; registered intervention is the SonoCloud device only. Carboplatin is listed as the drug whose BBB delivery is tested (every patient receives it) and SonoVue as the delivery-enabling contrast agent; neither is a registered drug intervention. Glioblastoma is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arms (only in the description as the earlier adult trial).
